groups.defect: The members endpoint fails to bound limit and offset, allowing invalid or excessive pagination values.
groups.rationale: Both report the same missing validation on the same parameters and SQL query. SQL errors, invalid client page numbers, and excessive result sizes are consequences of that shared defect.

groups.defect: totalPages overcounts by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, enabling navigation to an empty page.
groups.rationale: All four identify the same floor-division calculation and resulting empty final page. Replacing it with ceiling division resolves every report.
